x-e-e6-03.title: Ingabe iklabhu yezincwadi iyimpumelelo? Ukuguqula isahlulelo sakho njengoba ubufakazi bukhula

x-e-e6-03.material: Iklabhu entsha yezincwadi iqalile esikoleni sethu. Uthisha wathi, "The club is a success." Uzothola ubufakazi ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi bese ucabanga ukuthi lesi sitatimende silungile yini.

x-e-e6-03.thinking.2: Ukubhala isimangalo ngokuhlanganisa izingcezu eziningana zobufakazi

x-e-e6-04.title: Ukwenza amatafula ukuthola amacala lapho isitatimende siyiqiniso
x-e-e6-04.goal: Yenza amatafula amaningana amavoti wena lapho isitatimende sesiNgisi 'it got the most votes, but not half of the class' siyiqiniso.
x-e-e6-04.material: Abafundi abangu-20 eklasini baphonse ivoti elilodwa ngamunye lomsebenzi ngemva kwesikhathi sokudla okulula: i-soccer, ubuciko, noma umculo. Amavoti abizwa ngokuthi s (i-soccer), a (ubuciko), no-m (umculo).
x-e-e6-04.thinking.1: Ukwenza izibonelo ezifeza imibandela eminingana ngasikhathi sinye
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.prompt: Umphumela waba i-soccer amavoti angu-8, ubuciko amavoti angu-6, umculo amavoti angu-6. Ngumuphi umusho ochaza kahle kakhulu?
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.hint.0: Engeza u-8, 6, no-6, uthole ukuthi isigamu sabafundi abangu-20 siyini, bese uqhathanisa.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi 'most' no-'everyone' ngamunye usho ini.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.r.a: Hlola ukuthi yomibili imibandela iqinisekiswe ngezinombolo.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.r.c: Qhathanisa futhi ukuthi u-8 mkhulu noma mncane kuno-10.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.explain: Amavoti angu-8 angaphezu kobuciko (6) nomculo (6), ngakho okuningi kakhulu, futhi angaphansi kuka-10, isigamu sika-20, ngakho akusona isigamu. Ngakho a ilungile.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amatafula amavoti ama-3 ahlukile anabafundi abangu-20 sekukonke lapho isitatimende esifanayo ('i-soccer ithole amavoti amaningi kakhulu, kodwa hhayi isigamu') siyiqiniso.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.hint.0: I-soccer kumele ibe nawo amaningi kakhulu, ngakho qala ngokukhetha inani elikhulu kunobuciko nomculo.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.hint.1: Misa i-soccer ibe yinani elilodwa, bese uyisusa ku-20 uhlukanise okusele phakathi kobuciko nomculo. Uma i-soccer incane kakhulu, awukwazi ukufinyelela ku-20.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Amavoti ayizinombolo ezigcwele ezingu-0 noma ngaphezulu.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Bhala amavoti njengezinombolo ezigcwele ezingu-0 noma ngaphezulu.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c3: I-soccer ayinawo amaningi kuno-ubuciko noma umculo.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.explain: Ukuze i-soccer ibe nawo amaningi kakhulu, ubuciko nomculo ngamunye kumele kube mncane kuno-s, futhi isamba sabo ngu-20-s. Uma s=7, ngakho a+m=13, ngakho abakwazi ukuba bobabili ngu-6 noma ngaphansi, ngakho iyehluleka, futhi uma s ingu-10 noma ngaphezulu iyisigamu. Ngakho s ingaba ngu-8 noma 9 kuphela.

x-e-e6-01.material:
Ikilasi 6-3 likhuluma ngo-"Should we keep a class pet?" Nanku umbhalo kaJin.

I think we should get a class pet. A pet can teach us to take care of animals. I like cats very much, and I want to see one every day. Class 6-1 had a fish last year, and students fed it by turns. Also, many students are afraid of dogs.

x-e-e6-02.material: UYuna uzothumela i-imeyili kuthisha wakhe, uMnu. Park, mayelana nomhlangano wesifundo sesayensi segoqo. Umtapo wolwazi ungasetshenziswa kuze kube ngu-5 p.m. ngoLwesine.
x-e-e6-02.thinking.1: Ukuqhathanisa izilungiso ezingenzeka: ngumugqa muphi ongashintshwa
x-e-e6-02.thinking.2: Ukuhlola ukuthi umusho olungisiwe uyahambisana nemigqa eminye
x-e-e6-02.prereq.1: Izisho ezilula ezifana ne-can, want to, after
x-e-e6-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa owodwa kule imeyili ongahambisani nemigqa eminye, ukuze umhlangano ungasebenzi.
x-e-e6-02.s.s1.hint.0: Beka isikhathi somhlangano eceleni kwesikhathi lapho ilungu elilodwa legoqo lingafika khona, bese uziqhathanisa.
x-e-e6-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala usuku nesikhathi somugqa ngamunye, kuhlanganise ne-'a.m./p.m.'.
x-e-e6-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 ucela ukuhlangana ngo-3 p.m. ngoLwesine, futhi umugqa 4 uthi uMina angafika kuphela ngemuva kuka-4 p.m., ngakho imigqa emibili ayihambisani. Ungalungisa isikhathi somhlangano (umugqa 3) noma ushintshe izimo zikaMina (umugqa 4), ngakho samukela noma yimuphi umugqa owukhethile.
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.prompt: Bhala kabusha umugqa 3 ngesiNgisi ukuze umhlangano usebenze. Kumele futhi ukhumbule ukuthi umtapo wolwazi ungasetshenziswa kuphela kuze kube ngu-5 p.m.
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha isikhathi somhlangano phakathi kwesikhathi sokuqala uMina angafika ngaso nesikhathi umtapo wolwazi uvala ngaso.
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ungashintsha nosuku esikhundleni sesikhathi. Uma wenza kanjalo, hlola ukuthi umugqa 4 nawo usafanelana.
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.placeholder: Isibonelo: Our group wants to meet...
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Isikhathi osilungisile siphezu kwesikhathi uMina angafika ngaso (noma washintsha usuku)?
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Umusho wakho olungisiwe uhambisana nomthetho womtapo wolwazi ongu-5 p.m. nomugqa 4?
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Umusho wakho olungisiwe uxhumana ngokwemvelo nemigqa eminye ku-imeyili?
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Impendulo eshintsha usuku futhi yenza nomugqa wesizathu ufanelane.

x-e-e6-05.title: Isambulela esisodwa esimanzi singasitshela 'imvula iyana manje'?
x-e-e6-05.goal: Thola ukucabanga uMia akukholwayo ngokucabanga kwakhe okufushane ngaphandle kokukusho, bese wenza isimo ngesiNgisi lapho lokho kucabanga kungalungile.
x-e-e6-05.material: UMia uthe, "Dan came into the classroom with a wet umbrella. So it is raining outside now."
x-e-e6-05.thinking.1: Ukwakha isimo sesibonelo esiphikisayo lapho ukucabanga kuphula
x-e-e6-05.thinking.2: Ukusho imibandela lapho isitatimende sisebenza khona
x-e-e6-05.prereq.0: Amagama alula afana no-wet, rain, outside
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.prompt: Yiliphi ibhulo uMia angalishongo, kodwa okumele alikholwe, ukuze 'imvula iyana ngaphandle manje' kulandele?
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.hint.0: Buyela emuva isinyathelo ngasinye kusukela esiphethweni sikaMia ubone ukuthi kudingeka ini ukuze 'isambulela simanzi' sisho 'imvula iyana manje'.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.hint.1: Hlukanisa amaqiniso asevele ebhalwe embhalweni nezinkolelo ezingabhalwanga.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.a: Leli yiqiniso elisembhalweni. Hlola ukuthi liyincazelo efihliwe yini.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu ukusetshenziswa okuvamile kwezambulela. Cabanga ukuthi kuyisixhumanisi lokhu kucabanga okuludingayo ngempela yini.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu kukhuluma ngebhuloho eliwela kusuka ku-'manzi' liye ku-'imvula iyana manje'.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.explain: Ukusho ukuthi isambulela simanzi ngenxa yemvula manje, udinga ukucabanga ukuthi akukho enye imbangela. Isambulela singamanziswa noma imvula isiyekile, uma isambulela sigeziwe, noma sawela emanzini.
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umusho owodwa ngesiNgisi ngesimo lapho isiphetho sikaMia singalungile. Sho ukuthi kungani isambulela simanzi kodwa imvula ayinayi manje.
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ngezinye izinto ngaphandle kwemvula ezenza isambulela simanzi. (amanzi, isikhathi, indawo)
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.hint.1: Isimo esinesikhathi esihlukile nasyo siyenzeka, njengo-'The rain has already stopped.'
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Esimeni osibhalile, ingabe isambulela simanzi kodwa imvula ayinayi manje?
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ungabona ukuthi kungani inkolelo kaMia (akukho enye imbangela) ingalungile?

x-e-e6-07.title: Ukubhala impendulo enqaba ngokuphana isimemo sosuku lokuzalwa lomngane
x-e-e6-07.goal: Hlunga izingxenye impendulo enqaba isimemo ezidingayo (ukubonga, ukwala okucacile, isizathu, enye indlela), bese uzibhala wena ngesiNgisi.
x-e-e6-07.material:
Umngane wakho u-Sam uthumele umlayezo.

Hi! Can you come to my birthday party on Saturday at 2 p.m.? It is at my house. Please tell me by Wednesday.

Kodwa unohambo lomndeni ngoMgqibelo, ngakho awukwazi ukuya. Nasi isiqephu sakho sokuqala sempendulo: "I can't come to your party. Bye."
x-e-e6-07.thinking.1: Ukukhetha izingxenye ezinakekela imizwa yomunye umuntu
x-e-e6-07.prereq.0: Izisho ezifana no-can't / thank you for ~
x-e-e6-07.prereq.1: Amagama alula afana no-Saturday, next week
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.prompt: Yiziphi izinguquko ezingasiza ukushintsha isiqephu esingenhla sibe yimpendulo engcono enqaba isimemo? Khetha zonke ezifanelekile.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi u-Sam uzozwa kanjani lapho eyamukela, bese ufuna lokho isiqephu esishoda kona.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi kungani u-Sam edinga ukuthola impendulo ngoLwesithathu, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi ulwazi luni okukhethwayo ngakunye kunikeza u-Sam.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.a: Cabanga ngeqiniso lokuthi u-Sam kufanele anqume impendulo ngoLwesithathu.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.b: Lesi isenzo esiqala ngokuvuma imizwa yomunye umuntu.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.c: Qhathanisa ukuthi omunye umuntu uzwa kanjani uma kunesizathu nalapho engekho.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.d: Le yindlela yokugcina ubudlelwano buqhubeka ngemva kokwala.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.explain: Ukuqala ngokubonga nokuphakamisa elinye ilanga kwenza ukwala kuzwakale kungabandayo. 'Maybe' kwenza kube nzima ku-Sam ukwenza izinhlelo, futhi ukushiya isizathu kungabukeka njengokunganaki.
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.prompt: Bhala impendulo ku-Sam ngemisho emibili noma emithathu yesiNgisi. Faka ukubonga, ukwala okucacile (nesizathu), nesinye isiphakamiso. Isizathu akudingeki sibe uhambo lomndeni.
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala umusho owodwa ngamunye ngalokhu kulandelana: ukubonga, ukusho ukuthi awukwazi ukuya, isiphakamiso.
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenzisa igama elicacile elifana no-can't / cannot ekwaleni, bese uxhuma isizathu nge-because noma i-so.
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ifaka ukubonga, ukwala okucacile, isizathu, nesiphakamiso?
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngemva kokuyifunda, ingabe u-Sam angabona ngokucacile "awukwazi ukuza"?
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ithoni iyiSiNgisi esinethezekile esifanele umngane?

Futhi, ngifuna ukuboleka ibhola lomlenze ngesikhathi sokuphumula, ngakho ngizokwenza isicelo esifanayo emngane wami uMin nakuthisha wezemidlalo uMr. Han.
